findings.title: No observability signal detected
findings.explanation: No Sentry or OpenTelemetry reference was found in the scanned repository, and no observability system is declared in the engagement.
evidence: fde.yaml: no spec.systems entry of an observability type
findings.recommendation: Add tracing/error monitoring, or declare the customer's observability system in fde.yaml.

findings.title: Evaluation is not declared
findings.explanation: No evaluation requirement is declared for the engagement (spec.evaluation).
findings.recommendation: Define at least one task-success or regression evaluation before production.

findings.title: Reliability controls are not declared
findings.explanation: The engagement does not declare: timeout, retry, fallback (spec.reliability).
findings.recommendation: Declare timeout, retry, and fallback expectations for external dependencies and model calls.

findings.title: Infrastructure config references regions outside the declared residency boundary
findings.explanation: spec.constraints.dataResidency.allowedRegions declares ap-southeast-1, but the repository configures: us-east-1.
findings.recommendation: Move the workload into an allowed region, or update spec.constraints.dataResidency.allowedRegions after confirming the boundary with the customer.

findings.title: Declared read_only system "primary_db" has write-implying code signals
findings.explanation: fde.yaml declares system "primary_db" (type postgres) as read_only, but the repository contains code that appears to write to a postgres system. Each signal is a named heuristic, not proof — verify before deploying.
findings.recommendation: Either remove the write path, or change the declared access to read_write after confirming the boundary with the customer.
